principles.statement: Represent early reading as separate evidence for written-form access, lexical/construction interpretation, connected-text comprehension and fluency rather than one reading score.
Move learners beyond isolated sentences into connected microtexts as soon as prerequisite vocabulary and constructions make coherent meaning feasible.
Capture an independent first-pass reading attempt before revealing audio, glosses, translation or other comprehension support.
Store support provenance for reading attempts so unaided comprehension, comprehension after gloss, comprehension after translation and comprehension with audio remain distinguishable.
Estimate learner-by-text readiness from lexical coverage, construction readiness, text demands and task purpose instead of using one universal lexical threshold or CEFR label as a gate.
Prefer comfortably comprehensible graded material when the goal is sustained reading; do not treat unnecessary text difficulty or authenticity as a learning virtue.
Include sustained easy/extensive reading as a curriculum strand once learners can process connected graded text with low enough friction to maintain meaning across passages.
Use level-aware text choice and light accountability for extensive reading, but never convert pages, books or reading streaks into evidence of language mastery.
Treat reading-while-listening as an optional, fadeable scaffold for word access, pacing or fluency repair rather than the default proof of reading comprehension.
After audio-assisted or repeated reading, require a later unseen text-only self-paced probe before inferring independent reading development.
Measure reading fluency together with comprehension and support use; never optimize raw words per minute when meaning accuracy deteriorates.
Use repeated reading selectively for fluency or difficult-text repair and record exposure count; do not generalize faster rereading of a practiced passage to unseen-text fluency.
Introduce reading strategies in response to recurring comprehension problems and apply them immediately to real text rather than front-loading a large near-A0 strategy checklist.
Keep reading comprehension probes sparse and meaning-oriented so the product does not turn every paragraph into a quiz or every unknown word into compulsory vocabulary study.

Feed reading encounters into vocabulary, construction, transfer and review models while preserving whether the evidence came from reading, listening, support-assisted interpretation or productive use.

Keep exact message/microtext length, readiness bands, audio/gloss fading, repeated-reading dose, strategy timing and extensive-reading unlock rules falsifiable until EXP-013 validates them with Vietnamese near-A0 learners.
